# YomVezman 0.6.2 preview
App 0.6.2 (8), Apple silicon, macOS 14 or later. Testing prerelease, not an App Store-approved release.
Fixes reversed numeric cycle ratios in the Hebrew calendar footer. Lunar, solar and sabbatical positions now display in the same numeric order as English. Calendar calculations are unchanged.
The correction passed rebuilt English/Hebrew visual checks, 72 live regression tests and independent review.
Remaining testing limits: menu-bar-only and minimized-window recovery, location permission denial and Stop lookup, same-process network recovery, full keyboard/VoiceOver coverage, and remaining feature parity and Store preparation. This preview is not the 0.9.0 release candidate.
From 0.4.0 or later, use Check for Updates, Update, Install Update, then Install and Relaunch. Older versions need one manual installation. Updates remain user-confirmed.
